events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $2.98 (model confidence 0.86)
events.body:
The trip was metered (RydeTAXI, $52.08 total with distance and time components) [F6], so per RD-2 any non-exempt off-route distance maps directly into the fare and is refundable, unlike a fixed-quote service. The GPS record shows a single off-route segment 18:53–19:01 covering 3.98 km where the optimal route covers 1.87 km, adding 2.11 km [F1][F3]; RD-1 treats this as one deviation subject to the RD-3/RD-4/RD-5 exemptions, and the excess distance was in fact billed ($3.33 = 2.4 km × $1.41/km) [F4].

The driver's justification is a road breakdown, so RD-4(a) governs: the supporting traffic incident must sit on the replaced stretch of the optimal route and be reported before the segment began. The only incident fact is a vehicle breakdown reported at 18:27 located 0 m from the optimal route [F11], but the segment started at 18:53 [F3], i.e. the report precedes the segment only in time, and the trace records no qualifying incident matched to the replaced stretch [F11][F3]. Speed bands of 4 (30–39 km/h) on East Coast Parkway and Airport Boulevard [F9][F10] are at best corroboration under RD-4(b) and, being above band 2, do not establish congestion; RD-4(c) therefore routes the segment to RD-2.

Neither RD-5 nor RD-3 rescues the segment: there were no in-app chat messages at all, hence no driver route proposal accepted by the rider before 18:53 and no rider-named stop [F7][F3]. Weather was fair with zero rain, removing any other "reasonable cause" narrative [F12].

Amount: distance_fare $34.08 ÷ distance_km 24.2 km = $1.41/km [F6]; non-exempt extra distance 2.11 km [F3] × $1.41/km = $2.9751 → $2.98 (rounded to cents), per the RD-2 formula. The residual difference between the billed $3.33 [F4] and the segment sum is mapping residue and is not refunded under RD-2.

RD-6 does not apply: the driver has zero upheld route disputes in 90 days [F14], so no account flag is warranted on this case.

Because the fare is metered, that extra distance is refundable.

Nothing else is needed from you. The $2.98 voucher is applied to your account.

No account flag was added: you have no other upheld route disputes recently. Please follow the suggested route, or get rider agreement in the app before taking a different one.
